exposure: serum thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) level in first trimester
outcome: probability of delivering a male newborn
cohort: The study included 4,822 women who had thyroid function testing during the first trimester at a tertiary care center between March 2014 and February 2017.
finding: Maternal TSH level in the first trimester is positively associated with the probability of delivering a male newborn.
